title: ISRO-BAH-26: subsurface ice mapping and rover traverse planning at the lunar south pole with Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR
description:
Code for detecting and characterising subsurface water ice at the lunar south pole and planning a rover traverse, built for the ISRO Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026. Over a 60 x 60 km window around Faustini crater on the LOLA 20 m DEM, it resamples LOLA PSR, Diviner maximum temperature and depth to ice stability, LRO Mini-RF S-band CPR, LAMP Lyman-alpha ratio and Chandrayaan-2 DFSAR L-band polarimetric mosaics onto one grid; fuses roughness-corrected radar anomalies, LAMP and PSR evidence in log-odds space gated by thermal stability, with Monte-Carlo weight uncertainty; inverts the L/S CPR excess ratio for depth to ice with an enrichment significance test; estimates expected ice volume in the top 5 m; and plans a slope-constrained rover path with 8-connected A*.

Documentation: avinashistoocool.github.io/ISRO-BAH-26
